title: CG Oncology, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-13
summary: CG Oncology, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 13, 2026, announcing the appointment of Jim DeTore as Chief Financial Officer, effective immediately. Mr. DeTore, age 61, previously served as Interim Principal Financial and Accounting Officer since November 2025 under a consulting agreement with Monomoy Advisors, LLC. His compensation package includes an annual base salary of $520,000, a target annual bonus of 45%, a $4 million stock option award, and a $1 million performance stock unit award.
key_points: Jim DeTore appointed CFO on April 13, 2026, succeeding his role as Interim Principal Financial Officer since November 2025
Annual base salary of $520,000 with a 45% target bonus opportunity
Initial stock option award valued at $4 million with four-year vesting (25% after year one, remainder monthly)
Performance stock unit award valued at $1 million with vesting tied to commercial launch and positive operating cash flow
Severance benefits include 12 months base salary and bonus outside change-in-control, or 1.5x salary plus bonus within change-in-control
Mr. DeTore previously held CFO roles at Neurogastrx, Inc. (2021-2025), Proteostasis Therapeutics (2016-2017), and Bluebird Bio (2014-2016)
